source.citation: [The John Tyrrell house, 1720 S. Prairie Avenue (Otis L. Wheelock, 1868).] Undated photograph of the street front from the Prairie Avenue walk; photographer and original holder not named. Reproduced by the Glessner House Museum, 'Burley & Tyrrell, Chicago's Forgotten Retailer', The Story of a House (blog), 18 January 2022.
what_it_does_not_supply: a date, and so the 1904 state
the south flank, the rear and the roof behind the street face
what_it_supplies: the front's width against its eave, frieze, storeys and porch, read through the camera at the tyrrell front data
the principal floor about 1.55 m over grade (the porch floor and its stair)
the openings of the front: one door and three windows below, three windows and the bay above
the porch's span, its post groups and its plate
